faq.question: Can Indian students study Hospitality Management in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply to eligible English-taught hospitality and tourism programmes if they meet the academic, language, and programme-specific admission requirements.

faq.question: How long does a Hospitality Management degree take in Finland?
What is the tuition fee for Hospitality Management in Finland?
faq.answer: Fees vary by institution. Examples include €10,000 per year at Jamk and €11,000 per year at Haaga-Helia for the published programmes referenced above. Always verify the fee for your intended intake.

faq.question: Do I need IELTS to study Hospitality Management in Finland?
faq.answer: Not necessarily in every case. English-language requirements and accepted evidence differ between universities. Check the selected programme

faq.question: What is the Finnish Hygiene Passport and is it required?
faq.answer: The Finnish Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi) is a statutory certificate required for anyone handling unpackaged, perishable food in commercial kitchens, hotels, or restaurants. Universities prepare students to take and pass this test during their first year.
